name: Embedding Strategy Implementations
description: Implement 3 concrete embedding strategies: (1) SemanticStrategy - uses LLM for general semantic embedding, falls back to keyword-based feature hashing when no LLM available. (2) TechnicalStrategy - code-aware keyword extraction + hash-bucketed TF-IDF approximation, identifies code patterns, API references, technical terms. (3) SocialStrategy - builds author/mention graph embedding from signal metadata (authors, @mentions, channel participation). Each returns an L2-normalized numpy vector of fixed dimensionality (EMBEDDING_DIM=64). All must work without external services via deterministic heuristic fallbacks. Zero vector serves as no-information sentinel. All hashing uses hashlib.md5 for cross-process deterministic reproducibility.

functions.name: signed_hash
functions.description: Shared hashing utility. Computes a deterministic (bucket, sign) pair from a token string using hashlib.md5. The MD5 digest is split into two slices: bytes [0:8] determine the bucket index (modulo num_buckets), bytes [8:16] determine the sign (+1 or -1). This ensures cross-process reproducibility unlike the built-in hash() function.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: The token string to hash. Will be UTF-8 encoded before hashing.

inputs.name: num_buckets
inputs.description: The number of hash buckets (i.e., embedding dimensions to map into). Must be positive.

validators.error_message: num_buckets must be a positive integer.

preconditions: token is a valid UTF-8 string
postconditions: result.bucket >= 0 and result.bucket < num_buckets
result.sign in (-1, +1)
Calling with same (token, num_buckets) always produces same result (deterministic)

inputs.name: vector

preconditions: vector contains no NaN or Inf values
postconditions: If input is zero vector, output is zero vector
If input is non-zero, output has L2 norm == 1.0 (within floating point tolerance 1e-6)
Output has exactly EMBEDDING_DIM (64) elements
Output contains no NaN or Inf values

functions.name: zero_vector

functions.name: SemanticStrategy.embed
functions.description: Async method that produces a semantic embedding for the given signal. If an LLM service is available, attempts LLM-based embedding first (projecting/truncating to EMBEDDING_DIM if needed). On LLM failure or absence, falls back to deterministic feature hashing: tokenizes signal content into words, applies signed_hash to each token to accumulate into a EMBEDDING_DIM-sized vector, then L2-normalizes. Returns zero vector for empty content. The entire body is wrapped in try/except; any unexpected exception is logged as a warning and zero vector is returned.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The signal to embed. Uses content and optionally signal_type and tags for enrichment.

functions.name: TechnicalStrategy.embed
functions.description: Async method that produces a technical/code-aware embedding for the given signal. Pipeline: (1) Code-aware tokenization — splits camelCase, snake_case, and dotted paths into sub-tokens. (2) Regex-based pattern detection — identifies function definitions, import statements, API paths, error patterns, class definitions, decorators, dotted paths. (3) Hash-bucketed TF-IDF approximation — each token is mapped via signed_hash into a subset of embedding dimensions, weighted by approximate inverse document frequency. (4) Dedicated dimension ranges — the 64 dimensions are partitioned into ranges for general tokens (dims 0-31), pattern type indicators (dims 32-47), and pattern-specific token features (dims 48-63). Final vector is L2-normalized. Returns zero vector for empty/non-technical content. Entire body wrapped in try/except.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The signal to embed. Primarily uses content; signal_type and tags may influence pattern weighting.

functions.name: TechnicalStrategy.tokenize_code_aware
functions.description: Code-aware tokenizer that splits text into sub-tokens. Handles camelCase splitting (e.g., 'getUserName' -> ['get', 'user', 'name']), snake_case splitting (e.g., 'get_user_name' -> ['get', 'user', 'name']), and dotted path splitting (e.g., 'os.path.join' -> ['os', 'path', 'join']). Converts all tokens to lowercase. Filters out tokens shorter than 2 characters.
postconditions: All returned tokens are lowercase
All returned tokens have length >= 2
camelCase identifiers are split into constituent words
snake_case identifiers are split at underscores
Dotted paths are split at dots

functions.name: SocialStrategy.embed
functions.description: Async method that produces a social/graph embedding for the given signal. Extracts author, @mentions, and channel from signal metadata. Hash-projects each entity into embedding dimensions using signed_hash with entity-type-specific prefixes to avoid collisions (e.g., 'author:alice', 'mention:bob', 'channel:general'). Encodes co-occurrence of author+mention pairs as combined hash entries (e.g., 'pair:alice+bob'). Channel contributes to a separate dimension subrange. Final vector is L2-normalized. Returns zero vector when no social metadata is present (empty author, no mentions, no channel). Entire body wrapped in try/except.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The signal to embed. Uses author, mentions, and channel fields from metadata. Content is not used.
